summary: Split from MPI-539 (different module, independent root). Stale generation-complete OS notification: _doneCount in js/shell/notificationService.js:32 is module-level with no expiry, so a batch counted at 16:05Z fired an hour later on the landing page against an unrelated drain. Carries an unreproduced second half - install-toast spam during the agent Pod runs - with the one already-ruled-out path noted.

THIRD toast symptom reported by Fabio, and it is only half a toast bug - read this before starting. He saw 'Not enough disk space to install Boogu Image Edit. Free up space and try again.' (a) MESSAGE QUALITY, and this half IS MPI-540: routes/downloadManager.js:1688 builds a precise error carrying the numbers ('X needed, Y free') and js/services/downloadService.js:234, :608 and :635 all throw it away for the vague copy, so the user cannot judge whether the check was even right. Measured this session: Boogu Image Edit resolves to 20.8GB (boogu-edit-balanced, 7 deps); C: had 204GB free, G: had 30GB free, so the configured models root decides the verdict and the toast refuses to say. (b) NOT MPI-540: Fabio was installing Boogu ONTO THE POD - his words, 'Boogu Image was something that I was trying to install in the pod. I don't have it installed in my system.' A remote-intended install was evaluated against LOCAL disk, which is the same family as MPI-539 failure 4 - a queued install carries no engine identity and can resume or retry against the wrong engine. Settle which card owns (b) before writing any code; do NOT fix it as a toast.

todo -> doing. Fabio reported it live again: completion toasts arriving 10-20 minutes after the generations finished. The lateness is _doneCount, which has no expiry.
